add_calendar_event: add a calendar event with title, start and end datetime, tag, description, location, and attendees
get_calendar_event: get a single calendar event by its event ID and return all event details
delete_calendar_event: delete a calendar event by its event ID and remove it from stored state
get_calendar_events_from_to: get calendar events that overlap with a specified start and end date range
search_events: search calendar events by query string matching title, description, location, and attendees
